verdict.rationale: Interview intelligence (recording, transcription, AI summaries feeding scorecards, with consent handling) is a fair axis for an ATS like Workable, but nothing in the evidence pack documents it. The Workable Agent covers only top-of-funnel sourcing and screening, and the rate-candidate API is a developer building block, not AI interview notes.

support.subject: As a hiring manager, interviews get AI notes and summaries — recorded, transcribed, and distilled into the scorecard with candidate consent handled
